_doc: PRD §6.6 rule table. Patterns are matched at ingest against the assistant's hand-off text and the owner's own <bash-input> commands; only the matched ids are stored (text-free). The FIRST id in this list that a manual_step matched names its pattern; `infeasible` steps (device, App Store UI, credentials, sudo, system dialogs) are not penalized. Changing a regex needs `reindex`; reordering or flipping `infeasible` needs `reindex` too (class is stored at ingest).

patterns.re: (?i)password|api key|\btoken\b|secret|one-time code|keychain|\.p8\b|sign in with apple|auth refresh
